Canvas is Frankfurt School's central LMS for course organization, materials, assignments, communication, and student interaction.
The TEL team supports course setup and selected implementation tasks, but lecturers remain responsible for academic content, assessment design, and publication decisions.

## Lecturer checklist for Canvas setup

- [ ] In `Files` tab, create directories `slides`, `notebooks`.
- [ ] In `Home` tab, update the session overview
- [ ] In `Home` tab, check and update Lecturer Profile and Literature
- [ ] In `Home` tab, provide examination information at the bottom of the page
- [ ] Create reminder to post welcome message (based on `news.qmd`)
- [ ] Notify the TEL team via e-mail to publish the course.
- [ ] Define the main communication channel, such as Canvas Inbox, email, or in-class announcements.
- [ ] Make the communication channel explicit in the course or in a welcome announcement.
- [ ] Review the complete course using Student View before publication.
